headline: Kaz rises from 73rd to 51st on ARC-2

sections.text: Kaz gained 11.53 to 51.67, moving from 73rd to 51st on the ARC-AGI-2 public board in the past day.
This is a further climb for the entry after its earlier move into the top 100. Standings remain provisional, and medals are decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
